name: patch_camelyon
description: Patch Camelyon provides labeled histopathology image patches extracted from whole-slide lymph node images for detection of metastases. It measures a model's ability to classify image patches as tumorous or normal and is used to evaluate algorithms for cancer metastasis detection in pathology. The benchmark emphasizes high-resolution visual classification performance and robustness to staining and scanning variations.
reputation: A well-established and widely used benchmark in medical imaging and computational pathology for patch-level metastasis detection.
